parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-04 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 133.9 | 19.46 | 19.46
2 | 50.7 | 19.69 | 39.15
3 | 23.0 | 4.00 | 43.15
4 | 61.9 | 4.32 | 47.47
5 | 20.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

**Station:** H-04
**Curve type:** QH(K)-type (ρ1 > ρ2 > ρ3 < ρ4 > ρ5)
**Aquifer depth:** 39.15 – 43.15 m (Layer 3, 23.0 Ω·m, sandwiched between higher-resistivity layers 2 and 4)
**Recommendation:** Plan the borehole to penetrate at least to ~45 m, setting casing through the overburden (0–39 m) and placing the screen across the 39.15–43.15 m low-resistivity zone identified as the probable saturated aquifer horizon; confirm lithology and water strike with drill cuttings before finalizing screen placement.
